note: Roadmap built from the official descriptions and the guides read 21 Nov 2026 (PowerPyx 3-step roadmap expanded to 5 stages). Hours: story 60-80 (PowerPyx), checklist ~100 (PowerPyx/KeenGamer), strangers & cleanup 10-20 (KeenGamer).

stages.focus: Play the story, protect the one missable trophy, and start the early questlines. Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter — there is no mission replay.
stages.name: Story, Chapters 1-2 — protect the missable
stages.warning: Positive Mental Attitude: do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 after Down to Earth, before the chapter ends.

stages.focus: Finish the story, unlock partner free-roam after Coffee Break, and pick up the gear-gated trophies (Key Cloner, Snap Gun, Dye Pack Jammer, bank vaults).
stages.name: Story, Chapters 3-5 — gear gates open
stages.warning: Bank vaults unlock from the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is... — do it as soon as it appears.

stages.focus: Work the 100% checklist after the credits: stunts, races, shooting ranges, drones, cards, WAiNK, challenges, vehicles, gangs and exploration. Progress made during the story already counts.
stages.name: The 100% checklist grind
stages.warning: Cheats unlock after the story and disable trophies and saving — keep them off your platinum save.

stages.focus: Stranger strands are not part of 100%, so they are usually what is left. Finish the character questlines and the 8 qualifying stranger strands.
stages.name: Strangers & Freaks and character finals
stages.warning: Only certain strands count for Strangers & Freaks — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed.

stages.focus: Mop up the combat and miscellaneous trophies, re-check the five unsolved hidden trophies against fresh guides, finish 100% for A Long Road, and the Platinum pops.
stages.name: Cleanup and the Platinum
stages.warning: Five hidden trophies were still unsolved on 21 Nov 2026 — check the latest guides before your final run.
